kicker.en: Orientation, method, and two research modules
kicker.ko: 지향과 방법, 그리고 두 개의 연구 모듈
kicker.zh: 取向、方法与两个研究模块
kicker.ja: 志向と方法、そして二つの研究モジュール

meta_description.en: The theoretical and methodological orientation of the Circle of the Fish, and its two research modules on historical East Asian international orders and on race and gender.
meta_description.ko: 복어회의 이론적·방법론적 지향과, 동아시아 국제질서사 및 인종·젠더를 다루는 두 연구 모듈.
meta_description.zh: 河豚会的理论与方法论取向，以及关于东亚国际秩序史与种族、性别的两个研究模块。
meta_description.ja: 河豚の会の理論的・方法論的志向と、東アジア国際秩序史および人種・ジェンダーを扱う二つの研究モジュール。

orientation_lede.en: What holds the Circle together is not a shared object of study but a shared suspicion: that the entities the discipline takes for granted — sovereign states in anarchy, pursuing security under a single logic of survival — are one historically particular way of carving up the international, mistaken for the only one. Everything below follows from taking that suspicion seriously.
orientation_lede.ko: 복어회를 묶는 것은 공통의 연구 대상이 아니라 공통의 의심이다. 학문이 당연시하는 존재들 — 무정부 상태 속에서 생존이라는 단일한 논리에 따라 안보를 추구하는 주권국가들 — 은 국제적인 것을 분절하는 역사적으로 특수한 한 방식일 뿐인데, 그것이 유일한 방식으로 오인되어 왔다는 의심이다. 아래의 모든 것은 이 의심을 진지하게 받아들인 데서 나온다.
orientation_lede.zh: 把河豚会联结起来的，不是共同的研究对象，而是共同的怀疑：学科视为理所当然的那些存在者——在无政府状态下依循单一生存逻辑追求安全的主权国家——不过是切分「国际」的一种历史上特定的方式，却被误认为唯一的方式。以下的一切，都源于认真对待这一怀疑。
orientation_lede.ja: 河豚の会を結びつけているのは、共通の研究対象ではなく、共通の疑いである。この学問が自明視する存在者——アナーキーのもとで生存という単一の論理に従って安全を追求する主権国家——は、「国際的なもの」を切り分ける歴史的に特殊な一つの仕方にすぎないのに、それが唯一の仕方と取り違えられてきたのではないか。以下のすべては、この疑いを真剣に受け取ることから出てくる。

theoretical_kicker.ja: 五つのコミットメント

theoretical_lede.en: These are not doctrines the Circle enforces. They are the recurring moves our published work turns out to make, stated plainly enough that a reader can hold us to them.
theoretical_lede.ko: 이것은 복어회가 강제하는 교의가 아니다. 우리가 발표해 온 연구들이 되풀이해 온 수(手)를, 독자가 우리에게 따져 물을 수 있을 만큼 분명하게 적어 둔 것이다.
theoretical_lede.zh: 这并非河豚会强制推行的教条，而是我们已发表的研究反复采取的做法——写得足够明确，好让读者据此追问我们。
theoretical_lede.ja: これは会が強いる教義ではない。私たちの発表してきた研究が繰り返し取ってきた手を、読者が私たちに問いただせる程度に明示したものである。

theoretical.heading: Orders are ontologically complex, not merely culturally diverse
theoretical.body: We do not treat the Qing, the Ming–Chosŏn ritual order, or today's great-power rivalry as one reality described in several idioms. When Chosŏn envoys met the Panchen Lama at Qianlong's birthday, the Confucian party experienced a subhuman creature and the Lama experienced ignorant lay beings — different lived worlds inside a single order, not different opinions about it (Choi and Kwon, EJIR 2025). That premise, worked out through the ontological turn and read back from Pak Chiwŏn's own critique of the Qing court's appropriation of peripheral ontologies, also drives our accounts of U.S.–China rivalry as an encounter of ontological others and of a divided peninsula as a pre-individual field rather than two finished states.

theoretical.heading: Interpolity order, not the international system
theoretical.body: Our unit of analysis is the interpolity order — a configuration of polities held together by ritual, virtue, status and recognition rather than by mutual sovereign recognition. 'Chinese' hegemony was a reciprocal rule of virtue, an aretocracy, in which authority belonged to those who demonstrated civil excellence; sadae contains the seed of a monadological theory in which states are non-sovereign monads attuned to the coherence of the whole; the Spanish bid for Morocco in 1940 makes sense only against the organizing principle of an inter-imperial Europe from which Spain had been expelled. Sovereignty is one historical form among several, and we trace its arrival rather than assume it.

theoretical.heading: Order is made by sociocultural forces, not by states alone
theoretical.body: The transnational shi literati of China, Korea and Vietnam steered the foreign policy of what Choi calls symbiotic states and underwrote the normative basis of tributary relations; Ming and Chosŏn literati built envoy-poetry exchange into the medium of hegemonic co-construction. The same commitment runs through our contemporary work: rebel groups and the ICRC negotiating child-rights legitimacy, Amnesty's network form, colonial Korean magazines, K-pop fandom, Mexican women's everyday cooperation with cartels. Agency in world politics is distributed well below and across the state.

theoretical.heading: Hierarchy is racialized, gendered, and worn on the body
theoretical.body: Our second research module treats the standard of civilization as something its subjects helped constitute. Colonized Korean women defending bobbed hair as hygienic, efficient and emancipatory were arguing about modernity under three stacked hierarchies at once (Kwon, EJIR 2025); Japan traded naval tonnage for civilizational standing even after the racial equality proposal was rejected and the 1924 Exclusion Act passed (Oh 2025); Korean elites turned Eurocentrism itself into a technique of self-strengthening. Gendered protection in humanitarian law, and the media frames that convert misogyny into sarcasm, belong to the same argument.

theoretical.heading: Pluralization by complexification, not by national schools
theoretical.body: We reject the idea that a non-Western IR means a Chinese, Korean or Japanese national school. Chineseness has always been a contested, aspirational, transcultural ethos, so a durable Chinese IR must complexify its own tradition internally and others externally (Choi, RIS 2023); Korean IR was not an Americanized import but a bricolage in which Lee Yong-hee and his contemporaries reassembled colonial, Japanese and American materials into a knowledge order fitted to Korea's predicament (Ok). Relationalism, on the same reading, is not a position one adopts but continuous labour against the dualist grain of scholarly writing (Jackson and Heo 2022).

methodological_kicker.ja: 五つのコミットメント

methodological_lede.en: An ontological argument is only as good as the reading that supports it. The Circle's methodological commitments are therefore mostly commitments about sources: which ones, in which language, read how.
methodological_lede.ko: 존재론적 주장은 그것을 뒷받침하는 독해만큼만 좋다. 그래서 복어회의 방법론적 지향은 대체로 사료에 관한 지향이다. 어떤 사료를, 어떤 언어로, 어떻게 읽을 것인가.
methodological_lede.zh: 存在论层面的主张，其分量取决于支撑它的那份读解。因此河豚会的方法论取向，大体上是关于史料的取向：读哪些，用哪种语言，怎么读。
methodological_lede.ja: 存在論的な主張は、それを支える読解の質を超えない。ゆえに会の方法論的志向は、おおむね史料についての志向である。どの史料を、どの言語で、いかに読むか。

methodological.heading: 以意逆志 (iuiyeokji): reading intention against intention
methodological.body: Our 2023 methods workshop, held over five days at the East Asia Institute, built an interpretive approach to East Asian diplomatic sources out of a classical Confucian hermeneutic principle — meeting the text's will with one's own rather than extracting variables from it. In practice this is joined to Ricoeur's distanciation and Strathern's ethnographic moment: we let a source deconstruct the frame we brought to it, then rebuild the frame, which is why an envoy's travelogue can yield an argument about ontological complexity rather than an illustration of tribute.

methodological.heading: Multilingual archival work across incommensurable record sets
methodological.body: We read literary Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Spanish and Tibetan records against one another instead of privileging whichever archive is best catalogued. Members work with Chosŏn envoy records and Tibetan accounts of the same encounter, colonial-Korean periodicals, Iberian scholastic natural law as it reached sixteenth-century Japan, Cold War Korean and American files, Philippine and Nepali field interviews, and Admiralty and Foreign Ministry papers. Training is deliberate: Jangseogak classical Chinese, Qing document seminars, the Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics, Filipino, Tibetan and Mongolian civilization.

methodological.heading: Conceptual history and the future-passed
methodological.body: Following Koselleck, whom we read together, we treat concepts as carrying sedimented futures. The 1636 anti-accommodation debate is approached as a 'future-passed' rather than a specimen of the tributary system; geopolitics in early Cold War Korea is tracked as it converts 숙명 (fate) into 운명 (destiny); internationalism, dependency, and 'Korean Studies' are followed as they are translated, localized and institutionalized. Lydia Liu's work on translingual practice and our seminars on Getachew, Zarakol and Alexandrowicz set the terms.

methodological.heading: Historical process tracing and comparative case work
methodological.body: We build mid-range theory from paired and sequenced cases: two Anglo-French dyads and the U.S.–Japan dyad for naval power projection; the Ming–Qing transition, the Westphalian transition and Détente for status ascent; four phases from violation through blacklisting to compliance for rebel commitments, combining large-N, QCA and congruence tests. Several members trained at IQMR, and process tracing, concept analysis and large-N qualitative analysis are the shared vocabulary that lets historical and contemporary projects speak to each other.

methodological.heading: Interpretive social science and knowing-from-within
methodological.body: We hold that scholarly, expert and practitioner knowledge alike are produced relationally, from inside a community of practice, rather than by detached representation (Jackson and Heo, 'Ways of Knowing', 2025). Methodologically this licenses interviews and fieldwork alongside archives — thirty-seven interviews in Jalisco, repeated fieldwork in Mindanao and Nepal, survey experiments where the question is how a public reads a victim — and it obliges us to state our own position in the encounter rather than bracket it away.

modules_kicker.ja: 二つの共同研究プログラム

title.en: Power, Institution, and Ideas in Historical East Asian International Orders
title.zh: 历史上东亚国际秩序中的权力、制度与观念
title.ja: 歴史的東アジア国際秩序における権力・制度・観念

en: This module pursues a systematic theorization of material, ideational, and institutional structures and their changes in historical East Asian international orders, from the early modern period to the early twentieth century. Compared with the established studies of early modern and modern Europe, work on material, ideational, and spatial structures in East Asia remains rudimentary and undertheorized.

The existing literature has focused largely on comparing distinctive East Asian organizing principles with the European sovereign states system and the balance of power. Drawing on the burgeoning historical scholarship on East Asian international orders, this module instead investigates the operating components of those structures and their continuity and transformation at critical historical junctures.
ko: 이 모듈은 근세부터 20세기 초까지 역사적 동아시아 국제질서의 물질적·관념적·제도적 구조와 그 변화를 체계적으로 이론화하는 작업이다. 근세·근대 유럽에 관한 축적된 연구에 견주면, 동아시아의 물질적·관념적·공간적 구조에 대한 연구는 여전히 초보적이고 이론화가 덜 되어 있다.
기존 연구는 대체로 동아시아의 독특한 조직 원리를 유럽의 주권국가체계 및 세력균형과 비교하는 데 집중해 왔다. 이 모듈은 동아시아 국제질서에 관해 빠르게 축적되는 역사 연구를 발판 삼아, 그 구조들의 작동 요소와 결정적 역사적 국면에서의 지속과 변형을 규명하고자 한다.
zh: 本模块致力于系统地理论化历史上东亚国际秩序中的物质、观念与制度结构及其变迁，时段自近世延伸至二十世纪初。与关于近世和近代欧洲的成熟研究相比，对东亚物质、观念与空间结构的研究仍显粗略，理论化程度不足。
既有文献大多集中于把东亚独特的组织原则与欧洲主权国家体系及均势加以比较。本模块则以近年迅速积累的东亚国际秩序史研究为基础，考察这些结构的运作要素，以及它们在关键历史节点上的延续与转变。
ja: 本モジュールは、近世から二十世紀初頭にいたる歴史的東アジア国際秩序における物質的・観念的・制度的構造とその変化を体系的に理論化する試みである。近世・近代ヨーロッパについての蓄積された研究に比べると、東アジアの物質的・観念的・空間的構造をめぐる研究はなお初歩的で、理論化も十分ではない。
既存の研究はおおむね、東アジア固有の組織原理をヨーロッパの主権国家体系および勢力均衡と比較することに集中してきた。本モジュールはこれに対し、急速に蓄積しつつある東アジア国際秩序の歴史研究を足がかりに、それらの構造の作動要素と、決定的な歴史的転換点における持続と変容を明らかにする。

en: Intellectual and conceptual history of East Asian international law and thought
Interconnected maritime powers and maritime order in East Asia and beyond
Power, diffusion, and topos in East Asia
Status and institutional hierarchies in East Asian international orders
ko: 동아시아와 그 너머의 연결된 해양 세력과 해양 질서
zh: 东亚国际法与国际思想的思想史与概念史
东亚及其以外相互连结的海洋势力与海洋秩序
东亚的权力、扩散与场域（topos）
东亚国际秩序中的地位与制度性等级
ja: 東アジア国際法・国際思想の知性史と概念史
東アジアとその外部における連結した海洋勢力と海洋秩序
東アジアにおける権力・拡散・トポス
東アジア国際秩序における地位と制度的階層

title.en: Race and Gender in Historical East Asian International Politics
title.zh: 历史上东亚国际政治中的种族与性别
title.ja: 歴史的東アジア国際政治における人種とジェンダー

en: This module explores racial and gendered inequalities in historical East Asian international politics — not as a supplement to the study of power and institutions but as an account of how that power was constituted and that hierarchy made legible.
ko: 이 모듈은 역사적 동아시아 국제정치의 인종적·젠더적 불평등을 탐구한다. 권력과 제도 연구에 덧붙이는 보론이 아니라, 그 권력이 어떻게 구성되었고 그 위계가 어떻게 읽힐 수 있게 되었는지에 관한 설명으로서다.
zh: 本模块探讨历史上东亚国际政治中的种族与性别不平等——不是作为权力与制度研究的补论，而是作为对那种权力如何被构成、那种等级如何变得可读的说明。
ja: 本モジュールは、歴史的東アジア国際政治における人種的・ジェンダー的不平等を探究する。権力と制度の研究への補論としてではなく、その権力がいかに構成され、その階層がいかに読み取り可能になったのかについての説明として。

en: Decolonial and pluriversal approaches to race and gender
Reassessing racialized and gendered violence under Japanese imperialism and wartime occupation
The role of gender norms and of women in the making of international society
How Japanese colonial rule imposed racial hierarchies in East Asia in the context of Western racial ideologies
Eurocentric racial biases in international institutions and international law
ko: 일본 제국주의와 전시 점령기의 인종화된·젠더화된 폭력에 대한 재평가
국제사회의 형성에서 젠더 규범과 여성이 수행한 역할
서구 인종 이데올로기의 맥락 속에서 일본 식민 통치가 동아시아에 부과한 인종 위계
국제제도와 국제법에 내재한 유럽중심적 인종 편향
zh: 关于种族与性别的去殖民与复数世界（pluriversal）路径
重估日本帝国主义与战时占领时期的种族化、性别化暴力
性别规范与女性在国际社会形成中的作用
在西方种族意识形态的脉络中，日本殖民统治如何在东亚强加种族等级
国际制度与国际法中的欧洲中心主义种族偏见
ja: 人種とジェンダーへの脱植民地的・複数世界的（pluriversal）アプローチ
日本帝国主義と戦時占領下における人種化・ジェンダー化された暴力の再評価
国際社会の形成におけるジェンダー規範と女性の役割
西洋の人種イデオロギーの文脈のなかで日本の植民地支配が東アジアに課した人種的階層
国際制度と国際法におけるヨーロッパ中心的な人種バイアス

tagline: Many worlds make an order: East Asian ontologies for a plural International Relations.
